title: ABI Freeze Part 2
summary: Implemented all six assigned ABI modules, their specified constructors and derived traits, the Vec<u8> ByteSink implementation, and 35 inline unit tests. Source was manually reviewed. Compilation and automated validation were not run at the user's instruction.

implementation.number: NumericPolicy, Decimal128, DecimalPolicy, ConvertedNumber, and const policy/decimal constructors and accessors.
implementation.node: NodeWord packing and const accessors, Container32, DocumentParts, and ValidatedDocument.
implementation.schema: Schema identifiers, Opcode, image records, schema IR, compilation limits, SchemaImage, Selection, SlotValue, and ValidatedSlots.
implementation.endpoint: Every specified EndpointType variant plus EnumVariantSpec, EndpointField, EndpointSchemaSpec, and ServiceSpec.
implementation.wire: Every specified EnvelopeKind variant plus WireEnvelopeView and FramedHeader.
implementation.traits: ByteSink, its fallible Vec<u8> implementation, JsonDecode, JsonEncode, SchemaProvider, and ResourceBudget.

node_word.oversized_aux24: Mask to the low 24 bits without affecting kind or payload_index.
node_word.serialization: Integer bit layout is independent of host byte order; no serialized byte order is introduced.

vec_byte_sink.reservation: Vec::try_reserve is used before appending, so a reservation error preserves existing bytes.
vec_byte_sink.error_offset: Current output length, saturated at u32::MAX.

tests.reason: The user explicitly prohibited build, check, formatting, and compiler commands.
coverage: Const constructors, policy defaults, decimal bounds, scale preservation, and floating-point bit equality.
Node bit layout, auxiliary masking, field independence, every single-bit round trip, and container layout.
Identifier layout, opcode order, image-record offsets, zero defaults, IR constraints, selection, and owned clones.
All endpoint variants, parameter-sensitive equality, recursive types, service metadata, and response models.
All envelope kinds, missing versus zero metadata, full-width framing fields, and span preservation.
Fallible vector capacity reservation, deterministic capacity overflow, unchanged contents on failure, binary appends, and trait-object calls.
Default sink methods, error propagation, composed decode/encode/schema traits, and resource-budget boundaries.
Validated document and slot cloning, shared payload lifetime, and independently owned decoded storage.

integration_notes: Preserved the exact frozen field spelling allow_Quoted_int with a narrowly scoped naming-lint allowance.
All specified field ordering, representations, enum ordering, and derive sets are preserved.
The supplied specification names default-policy helpers without assigning their values; the selected values are documented above and in source.
For a concrete Vec<u8>, use ByteSink::reserve explicitly when the fallible trait operation is intended, since Vec also has an inherent reserve method.
C-layout records are in-memory ABI records; image serializers must handle fields and padding explicitly.
The sibling ABI modules and crate exports are owned separately and were not modified.
Build and test execution remains necessary during the later authorized integration phase.
